description: Paint gel streams drawn by the blobulator (paintblob shader): sp_a3_speed_ramp's repulsion and propulsion gel sprayers started and framed from a clear viewpoint, with named screenshots (QA_SHOT) of the frozen blobs as the isosurface, as its wireframe and as the fast-sphere fallback, and of the view before the sprayers start.
